Players Committee card image of [[Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may take a TIE Defender into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While piloting, opponent may not cancel or substitute battle destiny draws here. While piloting an Imperial starfighter, it is maneuver +2 and he draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/maareksteletheemperorsreach_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d7f8f0471e0da467f7416b6b60cb834ea8a0b87c d7f8f04] (21 February 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
